other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Wet corn milling / corn refining plants operate continuously 24/7 nearly year-round
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Typical plants in the US process at least 100,000 bushels per 
day (bu/day, or 2,500 tonne/day) and operate continuously for nearly 365 days per year.
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: corn refining / wet corn milling (food & agricultural processing)

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Corn refining described as a sophisticated continuous process producing sweeteners, ethanol, starch as co-products
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Wet corn milling (SIC 2046 or NAICS 311221), which is also referred to as corn 
refining, is a relatively sophisticated process producing a variety of products for the paper, food, 
beverage and other industries.

one_line: The paper empirically applies stochastic frontier analysis to build an ENERGY STAR energy-performance benchmarking tool for the U.S. wet corn milling (corn refining) industry, a continuous food/agricultural processing sector not among the eight registered Corpus B sectors; steel and cement are only mentioned illustratively.
